run_clear_meili_index_main: run the python module to delete all documents from a Meilisearch index using --meilisearch_key and --meilisearch_url arguments
run_clear_meili_index_temp: run the python module to delete all documents from the Meilisearch temp index using --temp flag
run_clear_embedding_db: run the python module to clear the Meilisearch embedding database for a specified index name
run_clear_meili_index_with_client: run the python module to connect to Meilisearch via Client and clear all documents from the given index
run_clear_meili_index_main_index: run the python module to clear the main Meilisearch index docs-semantic-search without deleting the index itself
